biological.citation: Hodson et al. 2014 - ADCY5 couples glucose to insulin secretion in human islets (PMID: 24740569)
biological.summary: ADCY5 mRNA in human islets is lower in carriers of the rs11708067 risk allele. ADCY5 silencing in human islets impaired glucose-induced cAMP increases, glucose metabolism to ATP, calcium transients and β-cell connectivity. GLP-1-induced calcium rises were unaffected, so ADCY5 couples glucose but not GLP-1 to insulin secretion.

biological.citation: ASHG 2015 - A functional regulatory variant associated with type 2 diabetes and fasting glucose levels at the ADCY5 locus (Roman et al.)
biological.summary: rs11708067 lies in an islet enhancer (FAIRE/DNase peaks, enhancer chromatin state). The G allele shows higher enhancer activity in 832/13 rat insulinoma reporter assays, allelic H3K27ac imbalance and differential protein binding in EMSA. Islet RNA-seq shows decreased ADCY5 expression for the risk A allele.

biological.citation: ASHG 2017 - An epigenetic switch confers pleiotropic risk for bone mineral density and hyperglycaemia (Sinnott-Armstrong et al.)
biological.summary: The 3q21.1 variant rs56371916 disrupts an SREBF motif and prevents Polycomb de-repression, causing ADCY5 downregulation in osteoblasts and adipocytes. ADCY5 downregulation impairs fatty acid oxidation and osteoblast differentiation and reduces adrenergic lipolysis. CRISPR C-to-T editing restored ADCY5 activation by SREBF1 and rescued differentiation and lipolysis.
biological.significance: ADCY5 down 2.7-fold in osteoblasts (p=0.0007) and 2.6-fold in adipocytes (p=0.0007); fatty acid oxidation p=0.003; ALP activity p=0.0014; lipolysis p=0.0012

biological.citation: ASHG 2017 - Physical interaction in human beta-cells between islet eQTL sites and target gene promoters at loci associated with type 2 diabetes risk and glycaemic traits (Torres et al.)
biological.summary: NG Capture-C in EndoC-βH1 β-cells showed the islet cis-eQTL co-localizing with T2D and glycemic-trait variants at ADCY5 maps within the interaction domain of the ADCY5 promoter. This supports enhancer-promoter regulation of ADCY5 as the effector gene.
biological.sample_size: 9 islet cis eQTLs (including ADCY5) tested in EndoC-βH1 cells

biological.citation: ASHG 2015 - The impact of known type 2 diabetes associated variants on circulating levels of GLP-1, GIP and glucagon during an oral glucose tolerance test (Jonsson et al.)
biological.summary: The ADCY5 T2D risk allele rs11708067 was associated with increased 0-30 min glucagon iAUC during an OGTT, indicating reduced glucagon repression. No association with GLP-1 or GIP survived multiple-testing correction.

biological.citation: Common genetic variants in ADCY5 and gestational glycemic traits (PMID: 32163478)
biological.summary: In Chinese Han pregnant women, ADCY5 SNPs (rs6797915, rs9856662, rs9875803) were associated with 1-hour glucose after a 50 g challenge. rs6777397 was associated with HOMA1-β and rs6762009 with HOMA1-IR.

biological.citation: ADCY5, CAPN10 and JAZF1 Gene Polymorphisms and Placental Expression in Women with Gestational Diabetes (PMID: 34440550)
biological.summary: ADCY5 SNPs rs11708067 and rs2877716 were not associated with GDM. ADCY5 expression was significantly increased in placentas from women with GDM compared with healthy women.
biological.significance: p<0.05 for expression (association of SNPs not significant)

biological.citation: Requirement of Zebrafish Adcy3a and Adcy5 in Melanosome Dispersion and Melanocyte Stripe Formation (PMID: 36430661)
biological.summary: In zebrafish, adcy3a-/-;adcy5-/- double mutants show defective melanosome dispersion, which PKA activation rescues. Adcy3a and Adcy5 act redundantly in α-MSH-MC1R/cAMP-PKA signaling, activating kinesin-1 and inhibiting dynein-1. They also regulate Mitfa, Tyr, Dct and Trp1b expression and melanin synthesis.

biological.citation: By inhibiting ADCY5, miR-18a-3p promotes osteoporosis and possibly contributes to spinal fracture (PMID: 33684620)
biological.summary: ADCY5 is a direct target of miR-18a-3p (dual luciferase and RNA pull-down). ADCY5 is downregulated in osteoporosis patient tissue and rises during hBMSC osteogenic differentiation. ADCY5 overexpression promoted calcium deposition, ALP activity and OSX/RUNX2 expression, and miR-18a-3p mimic reversed this.

biological.citation: ASHG 2011 - Linkage and single exome analyses identify ADCY5 as the gene for Familial Dyskinesia with Facial Myokymia (Raskind et al.)
biological.summary: The ADCY5 A726T missense variant co-segregated perfectly with familial dyskinesia with facial myokymia, affects a highly conserved residue and is absent from 1200 control exomes. ADCY5 is highly expressed in striatum, and Adcy5-deficient mice develop a stress-worsened movement disorder.
biological.sample_size: 5-generation family; 9 affected and 3 unaffected relatives; 1200 control exomes

biological.summary: circAdcy5 and linear Adcy5 mRNA were regulated in rat orbitofrontal cortex after heroin self-administration. circAdcy5 was among five heroin-responsive circRNAs, and Adcy5 was one of only two linear transcripts (with Grin2b) that also changed.
